svg.title: Unlimited transmission layout
svg.desc: Envelope of one hf transmission of CQ DE PY2: tune, sync train, header, a data frame, a short final frame, EOT and tail.
svg.text: Transmission layout: hf preset, “CQ DE PY2” (9 bytes)
Real Encoder output (48 kHz): T 32 ms, k 5, N 8, f_ref 2132 Hz; 44 slots + 100 ms tail = 1.508 s.
No lead-in: 0 ms on the HF presets (300 ms on the FM presets, for the FM transmitter's delay).
Each STOP is the next frame's START; the last sync marker is the header START.
The short final frame carries the last 4 bytes in ⌈32/5⌉ = 7 peaks; its STOP and the 2 EOT markers end the transmission.
